The Router missed the 'compression' artifact noted by the `perceptual_quality_auditor` (severity 0.2/slight), though this is minor compared to the text failure. The Router's severity 5 for text is appropriate as it fundamentally breaks the class function.

The alignment score is penalized heavily because the defining feature of a street sign—legible information—is absent.
